title: Approvals: the decide refusal and the submitter notice still name a no-approver position by its internal name, and the approver-type word stays English in every pack
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5okniknzVVR3KTSVr1

Filing gate: ① product defects with a named producer, found by the #36035 developer on PR #36306 (dev report on #36035, comment 7074647364, `out_of_scope_findings`). Filed as one family card on the seat's word. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 问题：#36035 让审批时间线上的「没有审批人」说明用岗位的显示名，但同一句话还出现在另外两处（审批被拒时的提示、给提交人的通知），那里仍是机器名；而且这句话里的「岗位」这个类型词在十一种语言里都是英文 `position`。
- 影响：中文读者会看到「担任 position '销售经理' 的成员」这样中英混杂的句子，或者直接看到 `legal` 这类内部名。
- 这一步做什么：让这几处共用同一个按读者语言命名的写法，并把类型词翻译进各语言包。
- 要你做的：无。

## What happens

1. **Two more doors still show the machine name.** The decide refusal (POST decide, `FORBIDDEN`; its text ends with the no-approver remedy) and the submitter's `approval.comment` notice both compose the no-approver `who` from the slate with no labels. The code is `noApproverRemedy` and `noApproverSentence(noApproverNote)` at the notify site in `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts`. `exclude-submitter.integration.test.ts` pins "…holds position 'legal'…".
2. **The approver-type word stays English in every language.** The `who` hole in `approvalNoApproverHolding` carries the English approver-type token in all eleven packs. A zh-CN read of an approvals actions list returns 目前还没有其他人能审批此请求。组织管理员需要添加一名担任 position '销售经理' 的成员… (pinned in PR #36306's test). The admin-rescue note translates the same thing (岗位「销售经理」). A fix needs a per-type clause in every catalog.

## Asked

- Every reader-facing place that names a no-approver slot names each position by the reader's pack label, then its declared label, then its name: the same order #36030 and #36035 use, through the same resolver (`notePositionLabels`), with no second one.
- The approver-type word in that sentence is translated in all eleven packs, the way the admin-rescue note already does it.
- Stored audit text stays as written.

## Done when

- The decide refusal and the submitter notice name a labelled position by its label in the reader's language; an unlabelled one keeps its name.
- A zh-CN reader sees no English approver-type token in the no-approver sentence.

Reader: `domain:ui` / approvals, `area:ux`. Related: #36035 (PR #36306), #35418 (PR #36030), epic #34571.

Dedupe: `no-approver remedy position label`, `approvalNoApproverHolding notification label`, `refusal remedy machine name`, `approvalNoApproverHolding who type token`, `no-approver note mixed language`, `position type word untranslated` (objectstack issues, open) → none found at filing.
